cases.question: 高血压人群一共有多少患者
cases.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT patient_id) AS patient_count FROM patient_profile WHERE lower(disease_tags) LIKE '%hypertension%'

cases.question: 糖尿病人群一共有多少患者
cases.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT patient_id) AS patient_count FROM patient_profile WHERE lower(disease_tags) LIKE '%diabetes%'

cases.question: 同时有高血压、糖尿病的人数是多少
cases.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT patient_id) AS patient_count FROM patient_profile WHERE lower(disease_tags) LIKE '%hypertension%' AND lower(disease_tags) LIKE '%diabetes%'

cases.question: 请计算高血压患者的平均糖化血红蛋白
cases.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.patient_id) AS patient_count, COUNT(DISTINCT l.lab_id) AS lab_count, ROUND(AVG(CAST(COALESCE(l.value, l.item_value) AS REAL)), 4) AS avg_value FROM patient_profile p JOIN lab_result l ON p.patient_id=l.patient_id WHERE lower(p.disease_tags) LIKE '%hypertension%' AND lower(l.item_name) IN ('hba1c')

cases.question: 请计算糖尿病患者空腹血糖均值
cases.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.patient_id) AS patient_count, COUNT(DISTINCT l.lab_id) AS lab_count, ROUND(AVG(CAST(COALESCE(l.value, l.item_value) AS REAL)), 4) AS avg_value FROM patient_profile p JOIN lab_result l ON p.patient_id=l.patient_id WHERE lower(p.disease_tags) LIKE '%diabetes%' AND lower(l.item_name) IN ('fasting_glucose')

cases.question: 请统计高脂血症患者 LDL 异常率
cases.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.patient_id) AS patient_count, COUNT(DISTINCT l.lab_id) AS denominator, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN lower(l.abnormal_flag) != 'normal' THEN l.lab_id END) AS numerator, ROUND(1.0*COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN lower(l.abnormal_flag) != 'normal' THEN l.lab_id END)/NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT l.lab_id),0),4) AS abnormal_rate FROM patient_profile p JOIN lab_result l ON p.patient_id=l.patient_id WHERE lower(p.disease_tags) LIKE '%hyperlipidemia%' AND lower(l.item_name) IN ('ldl_c')

cases.question: 请按风险等级统计患者人数
cases.gold_sql: WITH latest_risk AS (SELECT patient_id,risk_level FROM (SELECT patient_id,risk_level,created_at,visit_id,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY patient_id ORDER BY date(created_at) DESC,visit_id DESC) rn FROM patient_risk_score) WHERE rn=1) SELECT risk_level,COUNT(DISTINCT patient_id) patient_count FROM latest_risk GROUP BY risk_level ORDER BY patient_count DESC

cases.question: 请按药物类别统计患者人数
cases.gold_sql: SELECT drug_category,COUNT(DISTINCT patient_id) patient_count FROM medication_record GROUP BY drug_category ORDER BY patient_count DESC LIMIT 20

cases.question: 请统计高盐饮食患者血压异常率
cases.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ls.patient_id) patient_count,COUNT(DISTINCT l.lab_id) denominator,COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN lower(l.abnormal_flag)!='normal' THEN l.lab_id END) numerator,ROUND(1.0*COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN lower(l.abnormal_flag)!='normal' THEN l.lab_id END)/NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT l.lab_id),0),4) abnormal_rate FROM lifestyle_record ls JOIN visit_record v ON ls.visit_id=v.visit_id JOIN lab_result l ON v.visit_id=l.visit_id WHERE lower(ls.salt_intake_level)='high' AND lower(l.item_name) IN ('systolic_bp','diastolic_bp')

cases.question: 请计算各风险层级 HbA1c 平均值
cases.gold_sql: WITH latest_risk AS (SELECT patient_id,risk_level FROM (SELECT patient_id,risk_level,created_at,visit_id,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY patient_id ORDER BY date(created_at) DESC,visit_id DESC) rn FROM patient_risk_score) WHERE rn=1) SELECT r.risk_level,COUNT(DISTINCT r.patient_id) patient_count,COUNT(DISTINCT l.lab_id) lab_count,ROUND(AVG(CAST(COALESCE(l.value,l.item_value) AS REAL)),4) avg_value FROM latest_risk r JOIN lab_result l ON r.patient_id=l.patient_id WHERE lower(l.item_name) IN ('hba1c') GROUP BY r.risk_level ORDER BY CASE r.risk_level WHEN 'low' THEN 1 WHEN 'medium' THEN 2 WHEN 'high' THEN 3 ELSE 9 END
